# Cenvero Fleet

> Cenvero Fleet is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0-or-later), self-hosted fleet manager for Linux, macOS and Windows servers. A single controller binary (`fleet`) manages agents (`fleet-agent`) over encrypted, host-key-pinned SSH — directly, or in reverse mode where the agent dials out so servers behind NAT need no inbound port. There is no cloud account or hosted control plane.

Fleet provides persistent shells, concurrent commands across the fleet or a tag group with JSON output, chunked, parallel, checksummed and resumable file transfer, safe in-place file editing that keeps owner, mode and ACLs (next release), live directory sync, services, logs, journald, metrics, alerts, Slack and webhook notifications, background jobs, cron, playbooks, drift detection, a terminal dashboard, a dual-pane terminal file manager and a localhost web file manager. Safety features include fail-closed scoped RBAC tokens, encrypted named secrets, approvals, command policy, a dead-man's switch (`fleet guard`), minisign-signed anti-rollback updates and a hash-chained audit log. AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex can operate it: `fleet skill claude|codex|agents` installs an integration, `fleet context` prints the complete CLI reference generated from the installed binary, and `fleet ai <command>` prints the full help for one command. Install with `brew tap cenvero/fleet && brew install cenvero-fleet`, `curl -fsSL https://fleet.cenvero.org/install | sh`, or on Windows `irm https://fleet.cenvero.org/install.ps1 | iex`. The latest stable release is v2.4.3 (2026-09-11); the documentation follows the main branch and says which commands ship after v2.4.3.

## Docs

- [Complete reference](https://fleet.cenvero.org/llms-full.txt): key facts, overview, full documentation, fleet-agent reference, agentic-AI guide and release notes in one Markdown file
- [Documentation](https://fleet.cenvero.org/docs/index.md): install, setup, servers and transport modes, commands, files and sync, services, logs, health, alerts, automation, tokens, secrets, approvals, updates and the full command reference
- [Agentic AI](https://fleet.cenvero.org/agentic.md): how AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex discover and operate servers through Fleet, with guard rails
- [Overview](https://fleet.cenvero.org/index.md): what Fleet is, install commands, features, interfaces, transport, security and FAQ
- [What's new](https://fleet.cenvero.org/whats-new.md): release notes from v2.0 to v2.4.3 and what is in development

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/cenvero/fleet): source code (Go), README and issues
- [Releases](https://github.com/cenvero/fleet/releases): signed controller and agent archives for Linux, macOS and Windows
- [Changelog](https://github.com/cenvero/fleet/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): line-by-line history of every release
- [Security policy](https://github.com/cenvero/fleet/security/policy): how to report a vulnerability privately (security@cenvero.org)
